title: Body of Evidence — Common Definitions
description: Shared definitions reused across all Body of Evidence entity schemas.

boeId.description: A stable, immutable entity identifier in the format boe:<type>:<ulid>. Example: boe:claim:01HV8QKJZ9XTMK3P2R7N5W6D4F

isoDate.description: A date in ISO 8601 format: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD.

isoDateTime.description: A datetime in ISO 8601 format with timezone: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

confidenceLevel.description: Epistemic confidence on a 1–5 ordinal scale: 1=speculative, 2=weak, 3=moderate, 4=strong, 5=near_certain. Confidence measures evidence strength only. Whether a claim is disputed is recorded separately in disputeStatus; the assessed direction is recorded in conclusion.

confidenceLabel.description: Human-readable label corresponding to the confidence level. Must pair with the numeric level: 1=speculative, 2=weak, 3=moderate, 4=strong, 5=near_certain.

conclusion.description: The assessed direction of the evidence relative to the claim, separate from confidence. 'mixed' means credible evidence exists on multiple sides; 'insufficient' means the available evidence cannot resolve the claim.

disputeStatus.description: Whether the assessment is subject to an active formal challenge. Separate from confidence: a high-confidence assessment can still be disputed.

versionId.description: Immutable version identifier (ULID) for this specific version of the entity. The entity 'id' is stable across versions; 'version_id' is unique per version. A new version of an entity keeps the same id and gets a new version_id. Which version is current is determined by the investigation's package manifest, never by editing old files.

lifecycleStatus.description: The lifecycle state of an entity version. Note: there is no 'superseded' status — supersession is a property of the package manifest (an old version simply stops being listed as current), never a mutation of the old entity file.

investigationReference.description: A reference to an Investigation entity.

tags.description: Free-form tags for categorisation and search.

revision_ref.description: A reference to a Revision entity.

identifier.description: GitHub username or pseudonym of the contributor.

role.description: The contributor's role in relation to this entity.

conflict_of_interest.description: Disclosed conflict of interest, or 'none'. Required field.

origin.description: Where the source document originates (e.g., 'National Archives, RG 272', 'FOIA response from FBI').

obtained_via.description: How the source was obtained (e.g., 'Direct download from archives.gov', 'FOIA request #2023-XYZ').

authentication_notes.description: Notes on how authenticity was verified, or why it cannot be fully verified.

chain_of_custody.description: Ordered list of custodians through whose hands this document has passed.
